घुर् घुर्, cl. 6. P. घुरति, &c., to frighten
with cries, to cry out through fear, utter
cries of distress; to be frightful or terrible; to
sound; [cf. घोर.]

घूर् घूर्, cl. 4. A. घूर्यते, &c., to kill,
hurt, or injure; to become old, to decay.

घुरघुराय घुरघुराय, nom. A. -घुरा-
यते, to utter gurgling sounds, to wheeze, snort or
grunt like a hog; [cf. घर्घर and the next.]

घुर्घुर घुर्घुर, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic
word), a kind of worm, burrowing in the skin,
guinea-worm, Dracunculus; (ई), f. the mole-cricket
[cf. मृत्-किरा]; (आ), f. growling, as of a dog or cat.

घुर्घुरक, अस्, m. or (इका), f. a gurgling or
murmuring sound.

घुर्घुराय, nom. A. घुर्घुरायते, to whis-
tle, murmur, hum, &c.

घूर्ण् घूर्ण्, cl. 6. P. or 1. A. घूर्णति or
घूर्णते, &c., to move to and fro, to shake,
to be agitated, to tremble, roll about, cause to whirl,
whirl, turn round: Caus. P. घूर्णयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to move to and fro or shake.

घूर्णन, अम्, आ, n. f. shaking, revolving, whirl-
ing, turning round.

घूर्णमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being agitated, shaking,
trembling, revolving, turning round.

घूर्णायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, whirling, revolving,
rolling, tossing.
घूर्णि, इस्, f. rolling, revolving, going round or over.
घूर्णिका, f., N. of a woman.
घूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling, turning, tossing.

घूर्ण्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being agitated, set in
motion, made to go round.
